questions.question: Kia is a Japanese car manufacturer.
questions.explanation: Kia is a South Korean car manufacturer based in Seoul, not a Japanese one.
questions.fact: Kia is a South Korean automobile manufacturer headquartered in Seoul.

questions.question: Henry Ford founded the Ford Motor Company in 1903.
questions.explanation: Henry Ford incorporated the Ford Motor Company in Michigan in June 1903.
questions.fact: The Ford Motor Company was founded by Henry Ford in 1903.

questions.question: The Japanese car company Honda was founded by Soichiro Honda.
questions.explanation: Soichiro Honda founded the Honda Motor Company in 1948, and the company bears his family name.
questions.fact: Honda Motor Company was founded by Soichiro Honda in 1948.

questions.question: Before founding his car company, Ferruccio Lamborghini became wealthy by manufacturing motorcycles.
questions.explanation: Ferruccio Lamborghini made his fortune manufacturing tractors before he founded Automobili Lamborghini in 1963.
questions.fact: Ferruccio Lamborghini was a successful tractor manufacturer before founding Automobili Lamborghini in 1963.

questions.question: The British car brand Jaguar began in 1922 as the Swallow Sidecar Company, which made motorcycle sidecars.
questions.explanation: Jaguar started out in 1922 as the Swallow Sidecar Company and only took the name Jaguar Cars in 1945.
questions.fact: Jaguar was founded as the Swallow Sidecar Company in 1922, originally making motorcycle sidecars.

questions.question: Ettore Bugatti founded the Bugatti car company in 1909 in Milan, Italy.
questions.explanation: Although Ettore Bugatti was born in Milan, he founded his car company in 1909 in Molsheim, Alsace, which was then part of Germany and is now in France.
questions.fact: Ettore Bugatti founded Bugatti in 1909 in Molsheim, Alsace (then part of Germany, now France).

questions.question: The car brand Volvo was founded in Sweden.
questions.explanation: Volvo was founded in Gothenburg, Sweden, and built its first production car in 1927.
questions.fact: Volvo is a car brand founded in Gothenburg, Sweden.

questions.question: The Ford Model T was first introduced to the public in 1920.
questions.explanation: Ford introduced the Model T in 1908, not 1920.
questions.fact: The Ford Model T was introduced on 1 October 1908.

questions.question: In 2008, Ford sold Jaguar and Land Rover to the Indian company Mahindra.
questions.explanation: The buyer in 2008 was Tata Motors, not Mahindra.
questions.fact: In 2008, Ford sold Jaguar and Land Rover to the Indian company Tata Motors.

questions.question: Karl Benz's Patent-Motorwagen, patented in 1886 and often called the first true automobile, had four wheels.
questions.explanation: The Benz Patent-Motorwagen of 1886 was a three-wheeled vehicle.
questions.fact: Karl Benz's 1886 Patent-Motorwagen was a three-wheeled vehicle.

questions.question: The name 'Mercedes' in Mercedes-Benz comes from the daughter of the Austrian businessman Emil Jellinek.
questions.explanation: Emil Jellinek, a key Daimler dealer and racer, named the cars after his daughter Mercedes Jellinek.
questions.fact: The Mercedes name was taken from Mercedes Jellinek, daughter of Austrian businessman Emil Jellinek.

questions.question: The Toyota Corolla was first launched in Japan in 1966.
questions.explanation: Toyota launched the first-generation Corolla in Japan in November 1966.
questions.fact: The first-generation Toyota Corolla went on sale in Japan in 1966.

questions.question: BMW is a French car manufacturer.
questions.explanation: BMW (Bayerische Motoren Werke) is a German manufacturer based in Munich, Bavaria.
questions.fact: BMW is a German car manufacturer headquartered in Munich.

questions.question: The Patrol SUV is made by Toyota.
questions.explanation: The Patrol is made by Nissan, and Toyota's rival model is the Land Cruiser.
questions.fact: The Patrol is a long-running SUV model produced by Nissan.

questions.question: The German sports car company Porsche was founded by Ferdinand Porsche.
questions.explanation: Ferdinand Porsche founded the company that bears his family name in 1931.
questions.fact: Porsche was founded by Ferdinand Porsche in 1931.

questions.question: The Ford Mustang was first introduced in 1974.
questions.explanation: The Ford Mustang was introduced in April 1964.

questions.question: The British car company SS Cars changed its name to Jaguar Cars in 1945.
questions.explanation: After the Second World War the company dropped the SS name and became Jaguar Cars in 1945.
questions.fact: The company's name was changed from SS Cars to Jaguar Cars in 1945.
